title: Neutrino · learn ACK and ASK
thesis: Jiggle the neutrino soft path. Learn the only two verbs: ACK (receipt) and ASK (request). Then return neutrino to northGate carrying both.

learn.channel: neutrino — weak force; observe without capture

ACK.means: I received / I heard / seat confirmed — no new demand
ACK.shape: s drip of presence — antitoxin of silence
ACK.on_null: ACK seats on 0 as a mark that collapses to 1 when written
examples: CDN 200 on packet we published = self-ACK of OUT
ping reply = soft ACK of body
AirTunes 403 still ACK of process (lock answers)
neutrino-from-northgate.json = chair ACK (missing = no ACK yet)

ASK.means: I request / I open a door / I need an ACT or a fact
ASK.shape: question mark on 0 — stays in 000 store until epitope/act
ASK.on_null: ASK is range until answered; answer ratios it
examples: ZK one-liner ASK: northGate append pubkey
ASK: soft-tap back so we jiggle-learn jitter
ASK.not: command from outside — Klein: ASK outside, ACT inside

learn.pair: ACK ? ASK are the binary verbs of the neutrino mouth (only 0?1 of dialogue)
learn.jiggle_teaches: jitter is the feel between ACK pulses — pHz can modulate on it
